_README: The cost model behind the /ops margin figures. Every number here is an
ESTIMATE and is meant to be corrected against reality — weigh a finished
part on a kitchen scale, read the real print time off the slicer, check the
actual invoice from your filament supplier. Until then the margins on /ops
are indicative, and the dashboard says so.
Nothing in this file is customer-facing. It never ships to the browser.
Change a number, redeploy, and every figure on /ops updates.
_materialCostNote: Typical mid-market PETG at 1kg quantities. Colour does not meaningfully change this — same resin, different masterbatch. Buying 5kg+ of black is where the real saving is, not in which colours you pick.
_failureAllowanceNote: Reprints, failed first layers, purge waste. Applied on top of part mass. 8% is conservative for a dialled-in printer and generous for a new material batch.
_changeoverNote: Purged on each colour switch. Per SWITCH, not per part — which is exactly why the ops production queue groups by colour.
_machineCostNote: Electricity plus a depreciation allowance on the printer. Not labour.
_labourNote: Hands-on time per ORDER, not per part: removing from the bed, deburring, bagging, labelling, dropping off. Print time is machine time and is counted separately, because you are not standing there watching it.
_packagingNote: Box or padded mailer, poly bag, label, insert card.
_shippingNote: Assumed cost TO US of a domestic small parcel. Stripe reports what the customer PAID for shipping; this is what it costs, and the difference is the shipping margin shown on /ops.
_stripeNote: US card rate. Stripe reports actual fees per charge via the balance transaction; this is the fallback used when that expansion is unavailable.

glove-box-latch-96-00-civic._note: Latch body plus handle. Estimate from the 148x62mm envelope at typical wall/infill for a load-bearing interior part.

hvac-slider-knob-set-96-98-civic._note: Full knob set. Small parts, but the set prints as one plate so the time is dominated by travel and layer changes rather than volume.

door-handle-bezel-96-00-civic._note: Large thin-wall part with a reinforced corner radius. Per side.

hvac-symbol-set-96-98-civic._note: Base figures are the mid tier. Each tier overrides below — they are genuinely different amounts of plastic, and averaging them would flatter the cheap tier and punish the expensive one.

_bomNote: bomCostUsd on a part or variant is bought-in stock at cost — currently only the LED bulb set in the switch line's top tier. No failure allowance is applied to it: a spare LED is not a reprint.
